(4) Key data-testid attributes: salary-guide-page, tax-guide-page, savings-guide-page, mortgage-guide-page, debt-guide-page, freelancer-guide-page, location-salary-guide-page, pseo-breadcrumb, pseo-direct-answer, pseo-compare-section.
